title: 晶圓薄膜橢圓偏光量測
summary: 從p/s 偏振、厚度與 n到報告與限制：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From p/s polarization and Thickness-index coupling to Report and limits: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: p/s 偏振：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「偏振定義需相對於入射平面」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Polarization definitions are relative to incidence plane.
steps.instruction: 定義入射平面並標出 p 與 s 場方向。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Define the incidence plane and mark p/s fields. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 偏振定義需相對於入射平面；偏振器零點誤差會混入相位。
steps.observationEn: Polarization definitions are relative to incidence plane; Polarizer-zero errors contaminate phase.
steps.failure: 若採用「把水平與垂直永遠當 p 和 s」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating horizontal/vertical as universally p/s", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「p/s 偏振」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：偏振定義需相對於入射平面。
steps.checkEn: Submit the p/s polarization diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Polarization definitions are relative to incidence plane.

steps.title: p/s 偏振：故障判讀與驗證

Introduce this diagnostic principle: Polarizer-zero errors contaminate phase. steps.title: 薄膜干涉：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「光程同時包含厚度及折射率」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Optical path includes thickness and refractive index.
steps.instruction:
畫上表面反射與膜內往返路徑，標出相位差。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設正入射且 n=1.5、厚度 t=100 nm，單程光學路徑 nt=150 nm、往返 300 nm。另一假設薄膜 n=2、t=75 nm 也有同樣 nt。這說明 n 與 t 可能耦合，但不表示兩者的完整橢圓偏光譜相同；Fresnel 振幅、色散與吸收仍有差異。
steps.instructionEn:
Draw surface/interior paths and phase differences. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume normal incidence with n=1.5 and thickness t=100 nm: one-way optical path nt=150 nm and round trip 300 nm. A different hypothetical film with n=2 and t=75 nm has the same nt. This illustrates n–t coupling, not identical full ellipsometric spectra; Fresnel amplitudes, dispersion and absorption can differ.
steps.observation: 光程同時包含厚度及折射率；界面粗糙會改變有效反射。
steps.observationEn: Optical path includes thickness and refractive index; Rough interfaces modify effective reflection.
steps.failure: 若採用「只用幾何厚度而忽略 n」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

steps.check:
提交「薄膜干涉」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：光程同時包含厚度及折射率。
算例驗收：驗算兩組 nt，並列出至少一項可以幫助區分 n 與 t 的額外光學觀察。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Thin-film interference diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Optical path includes thickness and refractive index.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify both nt products and name an additional optical observation that could help separate n and t.
